done_when: For every card the customer asked about, one of two outcomes holds. (a) The customer has been told why no referral link can be provided: no documented program (re-checked once if the customer insisted), the program is closed, the claimed terms are incorrect (with the correct terms stated), or the referral would be rejected automatically. No tool was given, no document was requested, and there was no transfer. (b) The customer is verified and logged, has been given get_referral_link, has run it with their own user_id and the exact card name, and has heard the correct documented terms.
